content.short: LlamaPay is a multi-chain payment streaming protocol for salaries, subscriptions, vesting, and scheduled payments.
content.description: LlamaPay is a crypto payments protocol that automates outgoing and incoming payments across EVM chains. Teams can stream salaries by the second, schedule future transfers, set up recurring subscriptions, and use token vesting contracts without repeatedly sending manual transactions. Recipients can withdraw available funds whenever they want, while payers can manage open-ended streams and top-ups from a dashboard. On Mantle, LlamaPay provides a practical payment layer for DAOs, teams, and protocols that need recurring, transparent, and programmable crypto payments.
